sentences.text: Mechanism counterexample: GNAO1-related disease (neurodevelopmental disorder with involuntary movements) has P=0.93 but M=0.00, below support; it is excluded.

The counterexample gene GNAO1 participates in Reactome pathways R-HSA-162582 (Signal Transduction), R-HSA-195721 (Signaling by WNT), R-HSA-3858494 (Beta-catenin independent WNT signaling), and R-HSA-4086398 (Ca2+ pathway), and is annotated to GO:0007193 (adenylate cyclase-modulating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway), underscoring pathway distinctions that require verification for relevance here.
DEE37 shows phenotypic overlap with DEE4 and DEE74 by similarity metrics, which are candidates for shared features but need primary-source mechanism confirmation (S and V not established here).
DEE37 is also phenotypically similar to “cerebellar atrophy with seizures and variable developmental delay,” suggesting a partial overlap that remains to be mechanistically tested.
No corroborated cross-disease investigator bridge is mapped.

## Who shares our characteristics
Mechanism cluster label: DEE mechanisms; membership stability 1.00. [f6d7b0717195dc95]

## What already exists
Exact-match foundation Finding Hope for FRRS1L supports this disease group. [73c3e58f80ceb45c]
FRRS1L has observed loss_of_function variant class in ClinVar, consistent with deleterious alleles in this locus. [449e02838927bc3a]

## What differs and must be verified
Mechanism counterexample: GNAO1-related disease (neurodevelopmental disorder with involuntary movements) has P=0.93 but M=0.00, below support; it is excluded. [b0f727ee907516be]
The counterexample gene GNAO1 participates in Reactome pathways R-HSA-162582 (Signal Transduction), R-HSA-195721 (Signaling by WNT), R-HSA-3858494 (Beta-catenin independent WNT signaling), and R-HSA-4086398 (Ca2+ pathway), and is annotated to GO:0007193 (adenylate cyclase-modulating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway), underscoring pathway distinctions that require verification for relevance here. [28dfc2a4aa28527a, a3b67aec2863008b, ba1b3aa7d09e724e, 11d1dc1562388009, a51cda05b892c432]
DEE37 shows phenotypic overlap with DEE4 and DEE74 by similarity metrics, which are candidates for shared features but need primary-source mechanism confirmation (S and V not established here). [d30b8d092282e8a9, e0049dc271bca234]
DEE37 is also phenotypically similar to “cerebellar atrophy with seizures and variable developmental delay,” suggesting a partial overlap that remains to be mechanistically tested. [92307a1900838526]
